verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec published by Cerebras: a probe of the common OpenAPI and Swagger paths on the docs site returned 404 for every candidate. The llms.txt documentation index, the SDKs and OpenAI API compatibility are adjacent features, not a machine-readable API spec for this product, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
